why: Both analyses miss the key's bounded-growth march and offer near-identical training-led hedgehogs and brutal facts, but Analysis 2 goes further on the key's stop-doing and decline mechanism by ending the commission-only, fire-fast policy outright and putting period-end distributor loading in its top three and its decline warnings. Analysis 1 is slightly better calibrated (lower score, comp-basis assumption flagged, clearer statement of how missing data would change the answer), but Analysis 2 is the more useful document for the leader.
